text: The other order of 0129: the table first, on one alphabet in an unknown order, then every move of the type-1 library.

With the table first, each known letter's key slot is its own place in the message, as with no move; only the carved letter it sits under changes with the move. Lengths 9, 15, 17 and 19 are dead or nearly so for that reason.
No fit below key length 6. K4 is above all twelve coppers in none of the 52 cells; a copper manages 0-10 against the rest. Chance.
